description: Add business days to a date, or count them between two dates, for ~110 countries. Knows each country's weekend (Friday-Saturday where that applies, not just Sat-Sun) and its national public holidays, and names every day it skipped. Holidays observed only in some provinces are deliberately NOT treated as national closures — they are listed separately so you can apply them when your case is regional. Built for payment terms, SLAs and delivery dates.

to.description: …or an end date, to count business days instead

name: business_days
